_full_run_triggers.staleness: board restructured, or a recalibration landed AND IS ENABLED BY DEFAULT (see journal/0111 + the qualifier in staleness-sweep/SKILL.md — an off-by-default recalibration voids nothing), or watermark older than ~5 active days

_full_run_triggers.doc-topology: no reference side; incremental = changed docs read in full, then their NOUNS drive the search across everything else
